exposure: Hospital breastfeeding guidelines and improvement initiatives (delivery year)
cohort: The participants were 924 opioid-exposed mother-infant dyads.
finding: Hospital-level factors, specifically reduced restrictions in hospital breastfeeding guidelines and prenatal breastfeeding education, were the greatest predictors of breastfeeding initiation among opioid-exposed dyads.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was negatively associated with breastfeeding continuation compared to vaginal delivery (aOR 0.3 [95% CI 0.2-0.6]).
birth_weight: Measured as a characteristic in the study cohort.
gest_age: Measured as a characteristic in the study cohort.
